name: Henry Scott
bioAdditions: FamilySearch gives Henry a death date of 7 Apr 1895 and a wife, Margaret Ann Davis (1834-1884), with children from 1853. A New York county marriage record of a son, Walter S. Scott, names Henry as his father (S1). FamilySearch dates Stephen J. Scott's death to 19 Apr 1856 at Kingston.

sources.citation: FamilySearch published tree, Henry Scott (GM97-D3R), with attached index entries
